name: SectionCard
summary: A named section with a consistent heading, optional description and decorative icon.

props.name: title
props.meaning: Level-two heading and accessible section name.

props.name: description / icon
props.meaning: Supporting text and an aria-hidden decorative icon.

props.name: native section props
props.meaning: Includes children, className and native section attributes. The heading owns aria-labelledby.

accessibility: Uses a semantic section named by a unique h2. Icons are decorative; the title must communicate meaning without them.
usage: Group related settings below a page's h1. Parent layouts own grid placement; the card adapts to its available width.

examples.label: Settings section
examples.description: A synthetic settings group demonstrating the shared surface and controls.
